items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I took lessons from Cozy, when I was learning how to read... Now Cozy was responsible for me getting interested in learning about rudiments

ctx.x: Gee, I can't recall it either.

Yeah, well, anyway, that's the first time I ran in to Cozy Cole. Cozy Cole, Charlie Christian and [Fred Rand] was in town, and a guitar player that was with him that first started the multiple sounds on the recording --

items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember, Panama Francis took your place, right, eventually? [INTERVIEWER] J. C. Heard took my place, then Panama took J.C.'s.

ctx.x: set them down and let them start taking the instruments, starting back there with the ABCs, you know that ain't going to make it too much, you know, and Cab was good. I learned a lot. Cab was very disciplined, his band was.
I remember, Panama Francis took your place, right, eventually?
J. C. Heard took my place, then Panama took J.C.'s.
